senses.en: Cloth worn around the neck or head.

ex.en: She wrapped a wool scarf around her neck.
ex.zh: 她在脖子上围了一条羊毛围巾。

ex.en: In colder regions, a locally woven scarf can reflect traditional craftsmanship while providing essential warmth.
ex.zh: 在较寒冷的地区，当地织造的围巾既能体现传统手艺，又能提供必要的保暖。

col: wrap a scarf around your neck｜在脖子上围围巾
tip: 复数可用scarves或scarfs，前者更常见。

senses.en: a folding cover on a stick protecting against rain or sun
including several different groups, activities, or ideas

ex.en: We shared an umbrella on the walk home.
ex.zh: 走路回家时，我们共撑一把伞。

ex.en: An umbrella organisation can help small charities coordinate their activities and share resources more effectively.
ex.zh: 一个联合组织可以帮助小型慈善机构协调活动，更有效地共享资源。

tip: umbrella term指涵盖多个相关概念的统称。

senses.en: glasses with dark lenses that protect eyes from bright sunlight

ex.en: I put on my sunglasses before leaving the house.
ex.zh: 出门前，我戴上了太阳镜。

ex.en: Wearing sunglasses with adequate ultraviolet protection can reduce the risk of eye damage during outdoor activities.
ex.zh: 在户外活动时，佩戴具有充分紫外线防护功能的太阳镜可以降低眼睛受损的风险。

col: a pair of sunglasses｜一副太阳镜
tip: 通常用复数；一副说a pair of sunglasses。

senses.en: Attractive and pleasant to look at.
To a fairly large degree, especially in informal speech.

ex.en: We found a pretty cottage beside a quiet stream.
ex.zh: 我们在一条安静的小溪边发现了一座漂亮的小屋。

ex.en: Although pretty public gardens attract visitors, cities must also ensure that these spaces remain accessible to residents.
ex.zh: 虽然漂亮的公共花园能吸引游客，但城市也必须确保居民能方便地使用这些空间。

col: a pretty dress｜漂亮的连衣裙
tip: 作副词表示“相当”时偏口语，正式写作可用fairly。

senses.en: costing a large amount of money

ex.en: These boots are too expensive for my budget.
ex.zh: 这双靴子太贵，超出了我的预算。

ex.en: Housing in major cities is becoming increasingly expensive, forcing many young workers to live farther from their workplaces.
ex.zh: 大城市的住房越来越贵，迫使许多年轻职工住到离工作地点更远的地方。

col: an expensive mistake｜代价高昂的错误
tip: 物品贵用expensive，价格高用high。

senses.en: costing little money or less than usual
of poor quality and little value

ex.en: We found a cheap café near the train station.
ex.zh: 我们在火车站附近找到了一家价格实惠的咖啡馆。

ex.en: Cheap public transport can improve access to employment and reduce dependence on private cars in large cities.
ex.zh: 价格低廉的公共交通能改善大城市居民的就业可达性，并减少对私家车的依赖。

col: a cheap alternative｜便宜的替代选择
tip: cheap有时暗示质量差；中性表达可用inexpensive。

senses.en: pleasant or enjoyable
kind and friendly towards other people

ex.en: We had a nice picnic beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边愉快地野餐了一次。

ex.en: Although nice surroundings matter, affordable housing and reliable transport are more important to many urban residents.
ex.zh: 虽然宜人的环境很重要，但对许多城市居民而言，可负担的住房和可靠的交通更为重要。

col: be nice to someone｜友善地对待某人
tip: nice含义较宽，正式写作宜换成更具体的形容词。

senses.zh: 〈非正式〉搞恶作剧(以试探能否被容忍)

senses.en: How big or small someone or something is.
A standard measurement used for clothes and other products.
To sort by measurements or make something a particular size.

ex.en: This suitcase is just the right size for weekends.
ex.zh: 这个行李箱的大小正适合周末出行。

ex.en: Reducing class size may allow teachers to provide more individual support to students with learning difficulties.
ex.zh: 缩小班级规模或许能让教师为有学习困难的学生提供更多个别辅导。

tip: 问尺码用What size，不用How much size。

senses.en: more than is wanted, needed, or suitable
in addition; also

ex.en: This soup is too hot to eat now.
ex.zh: 这汤现在太烫，还不能喝。

ex.en: Public transport cannot attract more passengers if fares are too high for regular commuters.
ex.zh: 如果票价对日常通勤者而言过高，公共交通就无法吸引更多乘客。

col: too tired to work｜累得无法工作
tip: too强调超过合适程度；very只强调程度高。

senses.en: Only; no more than a particular amount or thing.
Very recently, or exactly at a particular point or degree.
Fair and morally right.

ex.en: I need just one more minute to finish packing.
ex.zh: 我只需要再一分钟就能收拾好行李。

ex.en: A just society should ensure that all children can access quality education, regardless of family income.
ex.zh: 一个公正的社会应确保所有儿童都能获得优质教育，不受家庭收入影响。

tip: 作副词可指仅仅、刚刚；作形容词指公正的。

senses.en: the number 80

senses.zh: 八十的，八十个的；八十岁的

senses.en: A currency unit used in the US and several other countries.

ex.en: I paid one dollar for this small notebook.
ex.zh: 我花了一美元买这本小笔记本。

ex.en: A stronger dollar can make imported goods cheaper for American consumers while increasing costs for overseas buyers.
ex.zh: 美元走强可使美国消费者购买进口商品更便宜，同时增加海外买家的成本。

col: the dollar exchange rate｜美元汇率
tip: 不只指美元，也用于加拿大元、澳大利亚元等。

senses.en: the act of exchanging something for money
a period when a shop sells goods at reduced prices
the amount sold or money earned from selling goods

ex.en: I bought these boots in the winter sale.
ex.zh: 我在冬季促销时买了这双靴子。

ex.en: The sale of locally produced food can support farmers while reducing emissions associated with long-distance transport.
ex.zh: 销售本地生产的食品既能支持农民，也能减少长途运输带来的排放。

tip: for sale指待售；销售额或销量通常用复数sales。

senses.en: A greater or additional amount or number of something.
To a greater degree or extent.
A greater or additional amount or number.

ex.en: Could you add more rice to my bowl, please?
ex.zh: 请再给我的碗里添点米饭，好吗？

ex.en: Governments should invest more resources in preventive healthcare to reduce pressure on hospitals in the long term.
ex.zh: 政府应加大对预防保健的资源投入，以长期减轻医院的压力。

tip: 可修饰可数或不可数名词；是 many、much 的比较级。

senses.en: used by the person speaking or writing to refer to himself or herself and one or more other people

ex.en: He arranged for us all to have a drink.
ex.zh: 他安排我们大家一起喝一杯。

ex.en: She’s invited us both.
ex.zh: 我们俩她都请了。

senses.en: Having lived or existed for a long time.
Having a particular age.
Belonging to an earlier period of someone's life.

ex.en: Our old dog sleeps beside the warm kitchen stove.
ex.zh: 我们家的老狗睡在温暖的厨房炉子旁。

ex.en: Preserving old buildings can protect cultural heritage while attracting visitors and supporting the local economy.
ex.zh: 保护古老建筑既能保护文化遗产，也能吸引游客并支持当地经济。

tip: an old friend通常指相识已久，不一定年纪大。

senses.en: Having lived or existed for only a short time
The babies of an animal

ex.en: A young kitten fell asleep inside my empty shoe.
ex.zh: 一只小猫在我空着的鞋子里睡着了。

ex.en: Young people need affordable housing and stable employment to build independent lives in large cities.
ex.zh: 年轻人需要负担得起的住房和稳定的工作，才能在大城市独立生活。

tip: the young指年轻人群体；动物的幼崽也可用young。

senses.en: Caring about others and willing to help them.
A group of things sharing similar features.

ex.en: Our kind neighbour brought us soup when we were ill.
ex.zh: 我们生病时，体贴的邻居给我们送来了汤。

ex.en: Schools should encourage students to be kind to others, helping create a more supportive learning environment.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生善待他人，帮助营造更有支持性的学习环境。

col: be kind to someone｜善待某人
tip: 形容词常接to；种类用a kind of加名词。

senses.en: requiring rules to be obeyed and standards to be met
following an exact meaning or limit without exceptions

ex.en: Our coach is strict about arriving on time.
ex.zh: 我们的教练对准时到场要求很严格。

ex.en: Strict environmental regulations can encourage manufacturers to adopt cleaner technologies and reduce harmful industrial emissions.
ex.zh: 严格的环境法规可以促使制造商采用更清洁的技术，减少有害工业排放。

col: strict about punctuality｜严格要求守时
in the strict sense｜严格意义上
tip: 对人严格用with；对事情要求严格用about。

senses.en: Showing respect and consideration for other people.

ex.en: The polite child held the door open for us.
ex.zh: 那个有礼貌的孩子为我们扶着门。

ex.en: Polite communication in the workplace can reduce misunderstandings and help employees build stronger professional relationships.
ex.zh: 职场中的礼貌沟通可以减少误解，并帮助员工建立更牢固的工作关系。

col: polite to someone｜对某人有礼貌
tip: 对某人有礼貌用be polite to，不用polite with。

senses.en: putting considerable effort and care into work

ex.en: Our hardworking neighbour grows vegetables for the whole street.
ex.zh: 我们勤劳的邻居种菜，供整条街的居民享用。

ex.en: Even hardworking students may struggle academically without access to suitable learning resources and support.
ex.zh: 即使是勤奋的学生，如果缺乏合适的学习资源和支持，也可能在学业上遇到困难。

tip: 是形容词；“努力工作”用动词短语work hard。

senses.en: Making something easier to do or understand.
Willing to help other people.

ex.en: Your map was helpful when we explored the village.
ex.zh: 我们游览村庄时，你的地图帮了大忙。

ex.en: Clear feedback is particularly helpful for students who are learning to organise their ideas in academic essays.
ex.zh: 对于正在学习如何组织学术论文思路的学生来说，清晰的反馈尤其有帮助。

col: find something helpful｜觉得某物有帮助
tip: helpful可形容事物有用，也可形容人乐于助人。

senses.en: Quick to learn, understand, or find solutions.
Showing skill or an original way of solving a problem.

ex.en: That clever child fixed the puzzle before lunch.
ex.zh: 那个聪明的孩子午饭前就解开了这道谜题。

ex.en: Clever design can make small urban apartments feel spacious without increasing their environmental impact.
ex.zh: 巧妙的设计可以让城市小公寓显得宽敞，同时不增加其环境影响。

tip: 比较级cleverer，最高级cleverest。

senses.en: nervous or uncomfortable when meeting or speaking to people
to move away suddenly in fear, especially of a horse

ex.en: Lina felt shy when she joined the new club.
ex.zh: 莉娜刚加入这个新社团时有些害羞。

ex.en: Small group discussions can help shy students gain confidence before speaking in front of the whole class.
ex.zh: 小组讨论可以帮助害羞的学生建立信心，为在全班面前发言做准备。

tip: shy away from后接名词或动名词，表示回避。

senses.en: To have information or understanding about something
To be familiar with a person, place, or thing

ex.en: Do you know how to fix this bicycle?
ex.zh: 你知道怎么修这辆自行车吗？

ex.en: Consumers need to know how their personal information is collected before they can make informed choices online.
ex.zh: 消费者需要了解个人信息的收集方式，才能在网上作出知情选择。

tip: 过去式knew，过去分词known；通常不用进行时。

senses.en: Belonging to or connected with the speaker and other people.

ex.en: Our kitchen smells wonderful when Dad bakes fresh bread.
ex.zh: 爸爸烤新鲜面包时，我们的厨房里香气四溢。

ex.en: Investing in public transport could improve our quality of life and reduce urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通可以提高我们的生活质量，并减少城市空气污染。

col: our daily lives｜我们的日常生活
our local community｜我们所在的社区
our shared future｜我们共同的未来
tip: our后须接名词；ours可独立使用。

senses.en: on certain occasions, but not always or regularly

ex.en: I sometimes take the longer route home through the park.
ex.zh: 我有时会绕远路穿过公园回家。

ex.en: Working from home sometimes improves productivity, although its benefits depend on suitable equipment and a quiet environment.
ex.zh: 居家办公有时能提高效率，不过其益处取决于合适的设备和安静的环境。

tip: sometimes是有时；some time是一段时间。

senses.en: a machine programmed to perform tasks automatically

ex.en: A small robot cleaned the floor while we ate breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们吃早饭时，一台小机器人清扫了地板。

ex.en: Robots can perform repetitive factory tasks, but workers may need additional training to move into new roles.
ex.zh: 机器人可以执行重复性的工厂任务，但工人可能需要额外培训才能转入新岗位。

tip: robot是可数名词；robotics指机器人学。

senses.en: used for a male person receiving an action or following a preposition

ex.en: My brother forgot his lunch, so I brought it to him.
ex.zh: 我哥哥忘了带午饭，所以我给他送了过去。

ex.en: When a student struggles with reading, teachers can support him through regular practice and constructive feedback.
ex.zh: 当一名男学生阅读有困难时，教师可以通过定期练习和建设性反馈帮助他。

col: give him a chance｜给他一个机会
tip: he作主语，him作动词或介词的宾语。

senses.en: Use your voice to say words or communicate with someone.
Be able to communicate in a particular language.
Address an audience about a subject.

ex.en: Could I speak to you after the lesson?
ex.zh: 下课后我能和你谈谈吗？

ex.en: Students who speak more than one language may find it easier to communicate across cultural boundaries.
ex.zh: 会说多种语言的学生可能更容易进行跨文化交流。

tip: 过去式spoke，过去分词spoken；语言前不用介词。

senses.en: to complete something or reach its end
the final part or end of something
the appearance or texture of a completed surface

ex.en: I'll finish washing the dishes before we go.
ex.zh: 我们出门前，我会把碗洗完。

ex.en: Students who finish their assignments early have more time to review feedback and improve their understanding.
ex.zh: 提前完成作业的学生有更多时间查看反馈并加深理解。

tip: 表示做完某事用finish doing，不用finish to do。

senses.en: the day after Sunday and before Tuesday

ex.en: We usually buy fresh fruit at the market on Monday.
ex.zh: 我们通常在星期一去市场买新鲜水果。

ex.en: Many employees find Monday mornings stressful because they must deal with tasks accumulated over the weekend.
ex.zh: 许多员工觉得星期一早上压力很大，因为他们必须处理周末积压的任务。

col: from Monday to Friday｜从星期一到星期五
tip: 星期首字母大写；用on Monday，但next Monday前不加on。

senses.en: the day after Monday and before Wednesday

ex.en: We usually have dinner together on Tuesday evenings.
ex.zh: 我们通常在星期二晚上一起吃饭。

ex.en: The community centre offers free language classes every Tuesday to help newcomers settle into the area.
ex.zh: 社区中心每周二提供免费语言课程，帮助新来者适应当地生活。

tip: 星期名称首字母大写；every Tuesday前不用on。

senses.en: the day after Tuesday and before Thursday

ex.en: We meet for lunch every Wednesday near the library.
ex.zh: 我们每周三在图书馆附近一起吃午饭。

ex.en: The community centre offers free language classes every Wednesday to help newcomers participate in local life.
ex.zh: 社区中心每周三提供免费语言课程，帮助新来者融入当地生活。

tip: 首字母大写；on Wednesday，但every Wednesday前不加on。

senses.en: the day after Wednesday and before Friday

ex.en: We usually meet for lunch at home on Thursday.
ex.zh: 我们通常周四在家一起吃午饭。

ex.en: The university will host a public discussion on sustainable transport next Thursday evening.
ex.zh: 这所大学将于下周四晚举办一场关于可持续交通的公众讨论会。

tip: 星期名称首字母大写；具体某天前用on。

senses.en: the day after Thursday and before Saturday

ex.en: We usually cook dinner together at home on Friday.
ex.zh: 我们通常星期五在家一起做晚饭。

ex.en: Allowing employees to work from home on Friday may reduce commuting pressure and improve job satisfaction.
ex.zh: 允许员工星期五居家办公，可能减轻通勤压力并提高工作满意度。

tip: 首字母大写；on Friday，但 next Friday 前不加 on。

senses.en: the day after Friday and before Sunday

ex.en: We usually buy fresh vegetables at the market on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我们通常星期六去市场买新鲜蔬菜。

ex.en: Opening public libraries on Saturday allows more working parents to participate in educational activities with their children.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆在星期六开放，让更多上班的家长能与孩子一起参加教育活动。

tip: 首字母大写；on Saturday，但this Saturday前不用on。

senses.en: the day after Saturday and before Monday

ex.en: We usually cook a big lunch together on Sunday.
ex.zh: 我们通常在星期日一起做一顿丰盛的午餐。

ex.en: Opening public libraries on Sunday allows people with busy weekday schedules to access essential community services.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆星期日开放，让工作日忙碌的人也能享用重要的社区服务。

tip: 星期名称首字母大写；on Sunday，但next Sunday不用on。

senses.en: Saturday and Sunday, often a time away from work.

ex.en: We usually visit the farmers' market at the weekend.
ex.zh: 我们通常在周末逛农贸市场。

ex.en: Affordable weekend activities can encourage families to spend more time together in their local communities.
ex.zh: 价格亲民的周末活动能鼓励家人在当地社区共度更多时光。

col: a long weekend｜连休的长周末
tip: 英式常说 at the weekend，美式常用 on。

senses.en: To clean something using water, often with soap.
To carry or move something through flowing water.
An act of cleaning with water.

ex.en: Please wash your hands before you help prepare dinner.
ex.zh: 帮忙准备晚餐前，请先洗手。

ex.en: Schools should teach children to wash their hands properly to reduce the spread of infectious diseases.
ex.zh: 学校应教孩子正确洗手，以减少传染病的传播。

col: give something a wash｜把某物洗一洗
tip: wash强调用水洗；clean泛指清洁，不一定用水。

senses.en: To look at something attentively for a period of time.
A small clock worn on the wrist or carried.
To take care of someone or look for possible danger.

ex.en: We watched the ducks swimming across the quiet pond.
ex.zh: 我们看着鸭子游过平静的池塘。

ex.en: Students who watch educational programmes may gain useful knowledge, but active discussion helps deepen their understanding.
ex.zh: 观看教育节目的学生可能获得实用知识，但积极讨论有助于加深理解。

tip: watch 强调持续观看；see 强调看见这一结果。

senses.en: to look at written words and understand their meaning
to say written words aloud
to understand information shown by something

ex.en: I read a few pages before bed every night.
ex.zh: 我每天晚上睡前都会读几页书。

ex.en: Children who read regularly often develop stronger language skills and a broader understanding of the world.
ex.zh: 经常阅读的儿童通常能培养更强的语言能力，对世界也有更广泛的了解。

tip: 原形读/riːd/；过去式及过去分词读/red/。

senses.en: Enjoy an activity or take part in a game
Perform music or a role, or make a recording run
A story written for actors to perform

ex.en: The children played with wooden blocks on the floor.
ex.zh: 孩子们在地板上玩木制积木。

ex.en: Schools should provide safe outdoor spaces where children can play and develop essential social skills.
ex.zh: 学校应提供安全的户外空间，让孩子们玩耍并培养重要的社交技能。

col: play a role in｜在…中发挥作用
put on a play｜上演一部戏剧
tip: 球类前通常不加冠词；乐器前通常用the。

senses.zh: 对难办的事采取踢皮球的态度

senses.en: The activity of preparing food by heating it.
Intended for use in preparing food.

ex.en: My brother does the cooking while I wash dishes.
ex.zh: 我哥哥做饭，我洗碗。

ex.en: Teaching basic cooking skills at school can help young people develop healthier eating habits.
ex.zh: 在学校教授基本烹饪技能，有助于年轻人养成更健康的饮食习惯。

tip: cooking指烹饪活动；cook可指厨师，cooker指炊具。

senses.en: many times or on many occasions

ex.en: We often walk by the river after dinner.
ex.zh: 我们经常在晚饭后沿河散步。

ex.en: People who exercise regularly often report better sleep and higher energy levels throughout the day.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼的人往往表示，他们睡得更好，白天也更有精力。

col: as often as possible｜尽可能经常
tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；t也可发音。

senses.en: An open area with grass and trees for public enjoyment.
To stop a vehicle somewhere and leave it there.
An area set aside for a particular activity or purpose.

ex.en: We shared a picnic under the trees in the park.
ex.zh: 我们在公园的树下共进了野餐。

ex.en: Providing a park within walking distance of every neighbourhood can encourage exercise and strengthen community ties.
ex.zh: 让每个社区步行可达公园，有助于鼓励锻炼并加强社区联系。

tip: 公园用park；英式英语中停车场用car park。

senses.en: needing rest or sleep because of physical or mental effort
annoyed or bored by something that continues or repeats

ex.en: I felt too tired to cook after the walk.
ex.zh: 散步后我累得不想做饭。

ex.en: Employees who regularly work long hours may become too tired to perform their duties safely.
ex.zh: 经常长时间工作的员工可能会疲惫不堪，无法安全地履行职责。

col: too tired to concentrate｜累得无法集中注意力
tip: tired形容人感到累；tiring形容事情令人累。

senses.en: Physical activities involving skill, effort, and often competition
To wear or display something in a noticeable way

ex.en: Swimming is the only sport my sister really enjoys.
ex.zh: 游泳是我姐姐唯一真正喜欢的运动。

ex.en: Regular participation in sport can improve physical health and help young people develop teamwork skills.
ex.zh: 经常参加体育运动能改善身体健康，并帮助年轻人培养团队合作能力。

col: take part in sport｜参加体育运动
tip: 泛指体育时英式常用sport，美式常用sports。

senses.en: used to give advice or say what is right
used to say something is expected or likely
used with have to describe an unfulfilled duty or expectation

ex.en: You should take an umbrella because it looks cloudy.
ex.zh: 你应该带把伞，因为天看起来阴沉沉的。

ex.en: Governments should invest in affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 政府应该投资于价格实惠的公共交通，以缓解拥堵并改善城市空气质量。

col: should be able to｜应该能够
tip: 情态动词，后接动词原形；should have done常指本该做却未做。

senses.en: referring to all members of a group individually
used to show how regularly something happens
used to emphasize all possibilities or a strong degree

ex.en: Every child brought a favourite toy to the picnic.
ex.zh: 每个孩子都带了一件最喜欢的玩具去野餐。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that every student has access to reliable internet services for learning.
ex.zh: 政府应确保每个学生都能使用可靠的互联网服务进行学习。

col: every reason to believe｜充分的理由相信
tip: every后通常接单数可数名词，谓语也用单数。

senses.en: a period of twenty-four hours
the part of each day when there is natural light
a particular period in the past or present

ex.en: We spent the whole day building sandcastles on the beach.
ex.zh: 我们一整天都在海滩上堆沙堡。

ex.en: Shorter working days may improve employee wellbeing while allowing parents to spend more time with their children.
ex.zh: 缩短每日工作时间可能改善员工的身心状态，同时让家长有更多时间陪伴孩子。

tip: every day意为每天；everyday是形容词，意为日常的。

senses.en: a plan showing when activities or events will happen
to arrange for something to happen at a particular time

ex.en: My busy schedule leaves little time for cooking during weekdays.
ex.zh: 工作日里，我繁忙的日程几乎不给做饭留下时间。

ex.en: Universities should schedule examinations carefully to give students sufficient time for revision and recovery between assessments.
ex.zh: 大学应合理安排考试，让学生在各项考核之间有足够的复习和休息时间。

tip: 英音开头通常为/ʃ/，美音为/sk/；on schedule指准时。

senses.en: Two slices of bread with a filling between them.
To place or squeeze something between two other things.

ex.en: I packed a cheese sandwich and an apple for lunch.
ex.zh: 我带了一个奶酪三明治和一个苹果当午餐。

ex.en: School cafeterias can promote healthier eating by offering sandwiches made with wholegrain bread and fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 学校食堂可以提供用全麦面包和新鲜蔬菜制作的三明治，促进更健康的饮食。

tip: 动词常用被动结构be sandwiched between。

senses.en: a cold dish of vegetables or other mixed ingredients

ex.en: I added cucumber and tomatoes to the salad.
ex.zh: 我往沙拉里加了黄瓜和番茄。

ex.en: Offering fresh salad in school cafeterias can encourage children to eat a wider variety of vegetables.
ex.zh: 学校食堂供应新鲜沙拉，有助于鼓励儿童摄入更多种类的蔬菜。

tip: 可指一份沙拉，也可不可数地指沙拉这种食物。

senses.zh: 汉堡包，火腿汉堡；牛肉饼，肉饼；碎牛肉
senses.en: a flat round piece of finely cut beef(= meat from a cow ) which is cooked and eaten in a bread bun
a drink made by putting tea leaves in hot water
dried leaves used to make tea
a light afternoon meal or, in Britain, an early evening meal

ex.en: I made a pot of tea while you rested.
ex.zh: 你休息的时候，我泡了一壶茶。

ex.en: In many cultures, sharing tea provides an opportunity for conversation and strengthens relationships between generations.
ex.zh: 在许多文化中，一起喝茶为交谈提供了机会，也增进了代际关系。

tip: 茶水通常不可数；点单时two teas指两杯茶。

senses.en: Recently produced or picked, and not preserved or stale.
Clean, cool, and pleasant, especially when describing air.
New or different from what existed or was used before.

ex.en: I bought fresh strawberries from the market this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我在市场买了新鲜草莓。

ex.en: Access to fresh fruit and vegetables is essential for improving diets in low-income urban communities.
ex.zh: 让城市低收入社区居民能获得新鲜果蔬，对改善其饮食至关重要。

tip: fresh water指淡水；fresh air指新鲜空气。

senses.en: physically well and not suffering from illness
helping to maintain or improve health
successful, strong, or developing in a positive way

ex.en: Our cat stays healthy with regular exercise and checkups.
ex.zh: 我们家的猫通过经常运动和定期检查保持健康。

ex.en: Schools should provide healthy meals to support children's physical development and encourage better eating habits from an early age.
ex.zh: 学校应提供健康膳食，以促进儿童身体发育，并鼓励他们从小养成更好的饮食习惯。

col: a healthy lifestyle｜健康的生活方式
tip: 既可形容身体健康，也可形容饮食等有益健康。

senses.en: Having a very pleasant taste.

ex.en: This delicious vegetable pie is still warm from the oven.
ex.zh: 这份美味的蔬菜派刚出炉，还热乎着。

ex.en: School meals should be both nutritious and delicious to encourage children to develop healthier eating habits.
ex.zh: 学校餐食应兼顾营养与美味，以鼓励儿童养成更健康的饮食习惯。

tip: delicious本身语气较强，常用absolutely加强。

senses.en: Having a taste like sugar or honey.
Kind, gentle, or thoughtful.
A small piece of sugary food eaten as a treat.

ex.en: These strawberries are sweet enough to eat without sugar.
ex.zh: 这些草莓已经够甜了，不加糖也好吃。

ex.en: Reducing children's consumption of sweet drinks may lower their risk of tooth decay and excessive weight gain.
ex.zh: 减少儿童含糖饮料的摄入，可能降低他们蛀牙和体重过度增长的风险。

tip: 糖果英式常用sweets，美式常用candy。

senses.en: to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it
a liquid for swallowing or a serving of it
to consume alcoholic beverages

ex.en: I always drink some water after walking the dog.
ex.zh: 我遛完狗总会喝些水。

ex.en: Encouraging children to drink water instead of sugary beverages may improve their dental health over time.
ex.zh: 鼓励儿童喝水而非含糖饮料，长远来看可能改善他们的牙齿健康。

tip: 不规则变化：drink—drank—drunk。

senses.en: feeling that you need or want a drink
having a strong desire for something

ex.en: I felt thirsty after walking home in the sun.
ex.zh: 我顶着太阳走回家后觉得口渴。

ex.en: Children who are thirsty for knowledge benefit from lessons that encourage questions and independent exploration.
ex.zh: 渴求知识的孩子能从鼓励提问和自主探索的课程中受益。

tip: 表示渴望某物用thirsty for，不用thirsty of。

senses.en: liked more than any other of the same kind
a person or thing someone likes best
the competitor considered most likely to win

ex.en: This little bakery sells my favourite kind of bread.
ex.zh: 这家小面包店卖我最喜欢的那种面包。

ex.en: Public libraries allow readers to discover new authors as well as revisit their favourite books without additional cost.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆让读者无需额外花费，既能发现新作家，也能重读自己最喜爱的书。

col: a firm favourite｜一直备受喜爱的人或物
the favourite to win｜夺冠热门
tip: 英式拼写favourite，美式favorite；一般不用most修饰。

senses.en: Things people or animals eat to live and grow.

ex.en: We packed enough food for a picnic by the lake.
ex.zh: 我们带了足够的食物，准备在湖边野餐。

ex.en: Reducing food waste at home can save money and lower the environmental impact of household consumption.
ex.zh: 减少家庭食物浪费既能省钱，也能降低家庭消费对环境的影响。

tip: 泛指食物时不可数；foods表示不同种类的食物。

senses.en: loved or valued very much
costing a lot of money
used to express surprise, worry, or disappointment

ex.en: This little garden is very dear to my grandmother.
ex.zh: 祖母十分珍爱这座小花园。

ex.en: Places that are dear to local residents deserve consideration when urban redevelopment plans are prepared.
ex.zh: 制定城市改造计划时，应顾及当地居民珍爱的场所。

col: dear to someone｜为某人所珍爱
tip: dear表“贵”主要用于英式口语；称呼常用Dear。

senses.en: a round vegetable with layers and a strong smell

ex.en: Chopping this onion is making my eyes water again.
ex.zh: 切这个洋葱又让我流眼泪了。

ex.en: Growing onions and other vegetables locally can shorten supply chains and provide communities with fresher produce.
ex.zh: 在本地种植洋葱等蔬菜可以缩短供应链，为社区提供更新鲜的农产品。

tip: 开头是元音音素，单数前用an：an onion。

senses.en: To make musical sounds with your voice.
For a bird to make pleasant musical sounds.

ex.en: We sing our favourite songs while washing the dishes.
ex.zh: 我们一边洗碗，一边唱自己最喜欢的歌。

ex.en: Children who sing together regularly may develop greater confidence and stronger relationships with their classmates.
ex.zh: 经常一起唱歌的孩子可能会变得更加自信，与同学的关系也更加紧密。

col: sing in a choir｜在合唱团唱歌
tip: 不规则变化：sing—sang—sung。

senses.en: the musical sounds made by birds and some other animals such as  whales

col: the song of the lark｜云雀的鸣唱

senses.en: to move your body rhythmically, usually to music
rhythmic movement to music, or an event for dancing

ex.en: We danced in the kitchen while dinner was cooking.
ex.zh: 晚饭还在做的时候，我们在厨房里跳起了舞。

ex.en: Traditional dance can strengthen community identity while offering younger generations a connection to their cultural heritage.
ex.zh: 传统舞蹈能够增强社区认同感，同时让年轻一代与自身文化遗产建立联系。

col: dance to music｜随着音乐跳舞
tip: 随音乐跳舞用dance to music，介词用to。

senses.en: Make a picture using a pencil, pen, or similar tool.
Move something by pulling it in a particular direction.
Attract people, interest, or attention to something.

ex.en: She drew a sleeping cat in her sketchbook.
ex.zh: 她在素描本上画了一只熟睡的猫。

ex.en: Free cultural events can draw more visitors to museums and encourage wider participation in the arts.
ex.zh: 免费文化活动可以吸引更多人参观博物馆，并鼓励公众更广泛地参与艺术活动。

tip: 过去式drew，过去分词drawn；另可指平局。

senses.en: a film or programme made using animated drawings or images
a humorous drawing, often commenting on society or politics

ex.en: We watched a funny cartoon about a dancing penguin.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于跳舞企鹅的搞笑动画片。

ex.en: Political cartoons can communicate complex social criticism through simple images that appeal to a wide audience.
ex.zh: 政治漫画可以通过简单的图像传达复杂的社会批评，吸引广泛的受众。

tip: cartoon 可指动画片或单幅漫画；漫画书常用 comic。

senses.en: To move through water using your body.
An occasion when you move through water for exercise or pleasure.

ex.en: We swim in the indoor pool every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每周六早上都在室内泳池游泳。

ex.en: Schools should teach children to swim because this essential skill improves both physical fitness and water safety.
ex.zh: 学校应教孩子游泳，因为这项基本技能既能增强体能，又能提高水上安全性。

tip: 不规则变化：swim—swam—swum。

senses.en: A game hitting a light ball across a table with bats
To move or pass repeatedly back and forth

ex.en: We played ping-pong together while waiting for dinner.
ex.zh: 等晚饭时，我们一起打了乒乓球。

ex.en: Community centres can offer inexpensive activities such as ping-pong to encourage social interaction among older residents.
ex.zh: 社区中心可以提供乒乓球等花费不高的活动，鼓励老年居民进行社交。

tip: 较口语化；正式比赛和写作常用table tennis。

senses.en: A social gathering where people celebrate or enjoy themselves.
An organised group seeking political power through shared policies.
A person or group involved in an agreement or dispute.

ex.en: We held a small party in the garden yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在花园里办了一场小聚会。

ex.en: Each political party should explain how its education policies will benefit students from disadvantaged backgrounds.
ex.zh: 每个政党都应说明其教育政策将如何惠及弱势背景的学生。

tip: 合同中的party指当事方，不是聚会或政党。

senses.en: coming immediately after the present one
immediately after this; on the following occasion

ex.en: Our next bus leaves in about ten minutes.
ex.zh: 我们要坐的下一班公交车大约十分钟后发车。

ex.en: Over the next decade, governments will need to invest more heavily in affordable public transport.
ex.zh: 未来十年，各国政府需要加大对价格可负担的公共交通的投入。

tip: “下周”用next week，不加the；the next week指随后一周。

senses.en: Extremely good or enjoyable.

ex.en: We had a wonderful picnic beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边度过了一段美好的野餐时光。

ex.en: Public libraries offer wonderful opportunities for children to discover new interests without placing financial pressure on families.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆为儿童发现新兴趣提供了极好的机会，又不会给家庭带来经济压力。

tip: 表示极好或令人愉快，不等于奇怪的。

senses.en: To gain knowledge or a skill through study or experience.
To find out information about something.

ex.en: My grandfather is learning to swim at the local pool.
ex.zh: 我爷爷正在附近的游泳池学游泳。

ex.en: Students often learn more effectively when they apply new knowledge to practical problems rather than memorise isolated facts.
ex.zh: 与死记零散知识相比，学生将新知识用于实际问题时，往往学得更有效。

col: learn from mistakes｜从错误中学习
tip: learn to do表示学会做；过去式可用learnt或learned。
